pairs.title: Customer update deck
pairs.request: Turn the launch notes into a five-slide customer update with a decision slide and a clear next step.
pairs.output_before: Slides: Overview; Progress; Milestones; Risks; Timeline; Team; Next steps. Rollout is being discussed.
pairs.output_after: 1 — Launch status. 2 — Milestones. 3 — Customer impact. 4 — Decision: Sara approves phased rollout Friday. 5 — Next step: Sara sends approval to the launch team.

pairs.title: Product overview
pairs.request: Create a concise product overview using the supplied visual hierarchy and positioning notes.
pairs.output_before: Our platform helps teams work better with AI through powerful features and flexible workflows.
pairs.output_after: Find what holds your AI back. Test a better setup on your own work. Review the evidence before changing anything. Start a private scan.

pairs.title: Launch message
pairs.request: Draft a short launch message with the approved positioning and one call to action.
pairs.output_before: Your AI already has tools. Brain Surgery shows whether it reaches them, then tests a better setup on the same work. Start a private scan today.
pairs.output_after: Brain Surgery finds where your AI setup fails, tests focused changes on the same work, and shows the evidence before anything changes. Start a private scan.

pairs.title: Partner reply
pairs.request: Reply in under 70 words, say what is needed and by when, and do not promise a launch date.
pairs.output_before: Hi Lena, Thanks for your thoughtful reply. We need your logo and a short quote by Friday. We will launch everything on Monday. Let us know whenever convenient and we will coordinate next steps.
pairs.output_after: Hi Lena, We just need your logo and a two-sentence quote. Could you send them by Friday? No extra preparation needed on your side. Thanks for being part of this.

pairs.title: Feature implementation
pairs.request: Implement the bounded feature and preserve the existing API contract.
pairs.output_before: Implemented the bounded option behind the existing method signature. Targeted tests: 8 passed. Public API unchanged.
pairs.output_after: Implemented the bounded option behind the existing method signature. Targeted tests: 8 passed. Public API unchanged.

pairs.title: Regression repair
pairs.request: Repair the reproduced regression without changing unrelated behavior.
pairs.output_before: Unable to reproduce a passing fix. Existing behavior left unchanged. No regression test added.
pairs.output_after: The setup change did not resolve the failure. Existing behavior left unchanged. No regression test added.
